mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that lowers equity discount rates, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines, or Rank IC remains below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate rises above 0.1% in a 3-month window, it signals imminent monetary tightening that increases equity discount rates, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of triggered periods, or Rank IC remains below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in payroll employment and decrease in unemployment rate indicates labor market tightening that boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of PAYEMS rising and UNRATE falling fails to produce positive 20-day returns in more than 55% of cases, or Rank IC for interaction term remains below 0.02 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: In a housing market expansion regime defined by HOUST above 1000 and GDPC1 above 16000, rising housing starts and strong GDP growth boost consumer confidence and investment, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: In the housing boom regime (HOUST > 1000 and GDPC1 > 16000), S&P 500 60-day returns are negative in more than 55% of cases, or Rank IC for regime condition remains below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: A declining unemployment rate indicates strengthening labor market conditions that support higher consumer spending and corporate profits, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE declines, or Rank IC remains below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production falls below 100 in a 3-month window, it signals manufacturing contraction that reduces near-term corporate earnings growth expectations, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of triggered periods, or Rank IC remains below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in CPIAUCSL and stable or rising FEDFUNDS indicates an inflationary environment triggering aggressive monetary tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of rising CPIAUCSL and rising/stable FEDFUNDS fails to produce negative 20-day returns in more than 55% of cases, or Rank IC for interaction term remains below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: In a manufacturing slowdown regime defined by INDPRO below its 12-month moving average, industrial output contraction reduces near-term corporate earnings, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: In the manufacturing slowdown regime (INDPRO < 12-month MA), S&P 500 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of cases, or Rank IC for regime condition remains below 0.02.
